none: PAS HAMP-46DEA8: Roman samian ware bowl base sherd
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn base sherd from a wheel-made Samian ware Roman bowl. The fabric has an oxidised mid-orange hue with dark orange colour coat. The sherd is now irregular in form, having been broken from its original circle. The lower surface features concentric rings produced during the making of the bowl. It is raised up on a stand, triangular in cross-section with rounded corners: L.: 12.9mm, Th.: 9.1 -…
